name: Barrage of Filth
summary: After this model shoots, select an enemy unit it hit; that unit cannot claim the Benefit of Cover until the end of the phase.

name: Blessed Icon of Disease
summary: Once per battle, at the start of any phase, remove Battle-shocked status from one friendly Death Guard unit within 12" of this model.

name: Blight Bombardment
summary: At the start of your Shooting phase, mark an enemy unit within 30" and visible to this model; until the end of the phase, friendly Death Guard ranged attacks against it re-roll a Hit roll of 1, or any Hit roll if made with a Blast weapon.

name: Blinding Spray
summary: In the Fight phase, once per battle per model with this ability, you can give that model's unit the Fights First ability until the end of the phase.

name: Blistering Fusillade
summary: If this unit has 5 or more starting models, or is led by a Character, its ranged attacks against Afflicted units gain +1 Strength and +1 Armour Penetration.

name: Boon of Death
summary: In the Fight phase, when a friendly Death Guard unit within 6" is targeted by an attack, this model can let melee-destroyed models in that unit that haven't fought yet roll a D6: on 2+ they fight before being removed.

name: Chaos Lord
summary: While this model leads a unit, models in that unit re-roll a Hit roll of 1 when they attack.

name: Curse of the Walking Pox
summary: When a Poxwalker in this unit destroys a non-Monster, non-Vehicle enemy model, you may return one destroyed Poxwalker to the unit after attacks resolve; a leading named hero's psychic kills count toward this too.

name: Death Approaches
summary: When this unit is set up on the battlefield using Deep Strike, it can be placed anywhere more than 6" from Afflicted enemy units and more than 8" from all other enemy units.

name: Death Guard Defenders
summary: While this model is within 3" of a friendly Death Guard Infantry unit, it gains the Lone Operative ability.

name: Desiccation Conduit (Aura)
summary: While an enemy unit is within this model's Contagion Range, at the end of the turn roll a D6: on 4+ that unit suffers D3 mortal wounds.

name: Diseased Icon
summary: Melee weapons equipped by models in the bearer's unit gain the Lethal Hits ability.

name: Diseased Influence
summary: When an enemy ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move within 9" of a friendly Death Guard unit that is within 6" of this model, that unit may make a 5" Normal move if it is not in Engagement Range.

name: Diseased Malice
summary: When this model attacks an Afflicted unit, add 1 to the Wound roll.

name: Eater Plague (Psychic)
summary: In your Shooting phase, target an enemy unit within 18" and visible to this psyker and roll a D6: 1 deals D3 mortal wounds to this model's unit instead, 2-5 deals D6 mortal wounds to the target, 6 deals D3+3.

name: Enfeebling Miasma (Aura)
summary: While a non-Monster, non-Vehicle enemy unit is within 6" of this model, models in that unit take Desperate Escape tests when it Falls Back, with -1 to the test if it is Battle-shocked.

name: Explosive Blight
summary: In your Shooting phase, when this model's attack destroys an enemy unit, before removing its last model roll a D6 (+1 if Afflicted): on 5+, every enemy unit within 6" becomes Afflicted until the start of your next turn.

name: Extraction of Fresh Disease
summary: The first time this model's unit destroys an enemy unit in melee, add 6 to this model's Objective Control characteristic for the rest of the battle.

name: Fevered Strategist
summary: Once per battle round, when a friendly Death Guard unit within 12" of a model with this ability is targeted by a Stratagem, reduce that Stratagem's CP cost by 1.

name: Foul Infusion
summary: While this model leads a unit, that unit's weapons gain the Lethal Hits ability and score Critical Hits on an unmodified Hit roll of 5+ instead of only 6.

name: Froth-spattered Frenzy
summary: If this model carries two melee weapons besides its close combat weapon, add 2 to the Attacks characteristic of those two weapons.

name: Gift of Contagion (Psychic)
summary: While this model leads a unit, that unit's attacks against Afflicted units gain the Sustained Hits 1 ability.

name: Gift of Poxes
summary: Add 3" to this model's Contagion Range.

name: Hail of Corrosive Disease
summary: After this model shoots, select a non-Monster, non-Vehicle enemy unit it hit; until the end of the phase, one friendly Death Guard ranged attack per phase against that unit gains +1 Armour Penetration.

name: Horrifying Visage
summary: When this model ends a Charge move, an enemy unit within Engagement Range of it must take a Battle-shock test with -1 to the result.

name: Host of Plagues
summary: At the end of your Movement phase, roll a D6 for each enemy unit within 6" of this model (+1 if Afflicted): on 3+, that unit suffers D3 mortal wounds.

name: Infectious Bloodshed
summary: When this unit makes a Charge move, until the end of the turn its weapons gain the Sustained Hits 1 ability.

name: Inflamed Infections
summary: At the start of the Fight phase, mark an enemy unit within Engagement Range of this model; this model's attacks against it score a Critical Hit on an unmodified 5+ (4+ if the target is Below Half-strength) until the end of the phase.

name: Inflamed Reprisal
summary: In the enemy Shooting phase, when a friendly Death Guard unit within 6" of this model is targeted, that unit may shoot back at the attacker as if in your own Shooting phase after the attack resolves.

name: Lethal Ichor
summary: When a melee attack is allocated to a model in this unit, after the attacker finishes its attacks, roll up to six D6: each 4+ deals 1 mortal wound to the attacking unit.

name: Lord of the Death Guard
summary: Once per turn, this model can use one of its listed Lord of the Death Guard abilities.

name: Malicious Calculations
summary: While this model leads a unit, attacks made by models in that unit can ignore modifiers to Ballistic Skill, Weapon Skill, or the Hit roll.

name: Metalophagic Infection
summary: After this model shoots, select an enemy Monster or Vehicle unit it hit; roll a D6 (+1 if Afflicted): on 5+ that unit suffers D3 mortal wounds.

name: Miasma of Pestilence (Aura)
summary: While a friendly Death Guard unit is within 6" of this model, models in that unit gain the Benefit of Cover against ranged attacks.

name: Pestilent Fallout (Psychic)
summary: After this model shoots, select an Infantry unit hit by its Plague Wind attacks; until the end of the opponent's next turn that unit is enfeebled, subtracting 2" from its models' Move characteristic.

name: Pestilent Familiar (Psychic)
summary: Once per battle, after this model's Psychic weapon selects targets, improve that weapon's Strength and Damage characteristics by 2 until the end of the phase.

name: POSSESSED
summary: For embarking in Transports, each model in this unit counts as one Terminator model.

name: Putrefying Stink
summary: Enemy models cannot start or end an Advance move within 9" of this model.

name: Putrescent Fog (Aura)
summary: Enemy units arriving as Reinforcements cannot be set up within 12" of this model.

name: Putrescent Vitality (Psychic)
summary: At the start of the Fight phase, you may roll a D6: on 1 this psyker's unit suffers D3 mortal wounds; on 2+, attacks allocated to models in that unit have Damage reduced by 1 until the end of the phase.

name: Sevenfold Chant
summary: In your Command phase, if this model is on the battlefield, roll 2D6: on a 7+, gain 1CP.

name: Shroud of Disease
summary: While this model leads a unit, that unit cannot be targeted by a ranged attack unless the attacker is within 18".

name: Sickening Vitality
summary: While this model leads a unit, add 1" to that unit's Move characteristic and re-roll Advance and Charge rolls made for it.

name: Silent Bodyguard
summary: While a Character leads this unit, that Character gains the Feel No Pain 4+ ability.

name: Spore-laced Shock Waves
summary: When this model's Plagueburst mortar targets a unit, roll a D6 for the target and every other enemy unit within 3" of it (+1 if Afflicted); on 6+ that unit suffers D3 mortal wounds after this model's attacks resolve.

name: Tainted Narthecium
summary: While this model leads a unit, in your Command phase you may return 1 destroyed bodyguard model to that unit.

name: Tank Hunters
summary: In your Shooting phase, each time a model in this unit attacks a Monster or Vehicle unit, add 1 to the Hit roll and add 1 to the Wound roll.

name: The Destroyer Hive
summary: While this model leads a unit, melee attacks against that unit subtract 1 from the Hit roll.

name: Tocsin of Misery (Aura)
summary: In the opponent's Battle-shock step, an enemy unit below its Starting Strength within 9" of this model must take a Battle-shock test, with -1 if it is a Psyker unit.

name: Unclean Icon
summary: While this model leads a unit, add 1 to the Objective Control characteristic of models in that unit.

name: Unholy Resilience
summary: The first time a model with this ability is destroyed in a battle round, roll a D6 at the end of the phase; on 2+, return it to the battlefield near where it fell, out of Engagement Range, with 3 wounds, once per battle.

name: Vector of Disease
summary: While this model leads a unit, melee weapons equipped by models in that unit gain the Sustained Hits 1 and Lance abilities.

name: Virulent Aura
summary: While this model leads a unit, models in that unit can re-roll the Wound roll when they make a ranged attack.

name: Pact of Decay
summary: When building your army, your Army Faction cannot be Plague Legions.
